1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Bb5 Nd4 5..strategy: Accepts the gambit and takes the pawn. White now has to consolidate against Black's lead in development, usually by retreating the knight with a hit on the bishop, and cannot relax until the pieces are safely developed.

Castles instead of recovering the pawn: Black sacrifices e5 for development, relying on the active knight on d4 and bishop on c5. A real gambit, so Black has to show that the activity is worth the pawn.
